_doc: The seven probe tiles and their fixed poses (docs/probes-2026-11.md): [x, north, height over ground, target x, target north, target height]; topdown = the top-down pose's centre. Run: tools/probes/run.sh <notes dir> (a dev server on 8784, a headless Chrome on 9333, the receiver on 8811).

_notes.b_sage_eye: By rule (tools/probes/pose_rule.js eye() with community 'Sagebrush', 2026-11-06): the old pose [8500, 2000] now stands in 'Rocky Mountain Lodgepole Pine Forest' (shrub 0 %, sward 0.16) after the rebuilds; the rule starts from the nearest cell whose species-mix row names Sagebrush (row 50, 'Inter-Mountain Basins Montane Sagebrush Steppe', 26,281 cells) and takes the nearest position (4 m grid, within 900 m) in that row whose shrub cover is within max(3, 20 %) of the row's median (28 %), whose sward averages at least the row's median (0.817) and nowhere falls under 0.75 of it, with no road within 20 m and no water within 30 m; the view keeps the old bearing. New pose 338 m off: shrub 32 %, sward 0.87 mean, 0.62 min.

_notes.b_valley_eye: By rule (tools/probes/pose_rule.js eye(), 2026-11-06): the nearest position (2 m grid, within 300 m) to the old pose [5300, 5300] in the same species-mix row (51: 35,705 cells), whose cell's shrub cover (canopy.png G) is within max(3, 20 %) of the row's median (34 %), whose sward (grass.js swardDensity over a 6 m disc and the foreground 4-16 m along the view) averages at least the row's median cell sward (0.841) and nowhere falls under 0.75 of it, with no road within 20 m and no water-system zone within 30 m; the view keeps the old bearing. The old pose stood in a bare patch (sward 0.66 mean, 0.007 min); the new one 11.7 m off: shrub 35 %, sward 0.99 mean, 0.65 min.
_notes.c_river: By rule (tools/probes/pose_rule.js river(), re-picked 2026-11-06 after the 1 m ground, the reroute and the flow-continuity permanence rule): the nearest position (1 m grid, within 300 m) to the old pose [5300, 4900] on the bank or terrace (water.png zone 3 or 4) of the highest-order stream within 150 m (order 6, the Lamar River), on dry ground (the water level at least 0.1 m under the ground there and within 3 m), within 25 m of the edge of the river's ribbon, looking at a perennial channel cell 40-120 m away nearest the old bearing whose water stands 0.1 m or more over the ground, with such water on the sight line within 25 m of the pose (so the view meets water, not a dry gravel bar), 0.3 m up. The previous pose looked across a gravel bar: the main stem there was coded intermittent (unmatched to NHD) and drawn dry in June. The new one is 9.5 m off, 8.1 m from the centreline, the target 100 m downstream (north-west), the bearing unchanged.
